messages:
Alex Chen: Handing off for the 09:00-17:00 shift. I'm primary until 17:00 UTC, Samir will be secondary. Quick status: no active P0s, a few latency alerts that auto-resolved overnight. See runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/latency
Samir Patel: ack. I'll be reachable on phone and pager. Any known coverage gaps?
Alex Chen: main gap is that our APAC fallback pool has reduced capacity due to the maintenance window on gpux-3 (ends 18:30 UTC). If we see regional fallbacks, prioritize traffic to eu-west-2.
Jia Park: noted. I updated the incident playbook section for fallback routing with the temporary weights (50/50 eu/us) under the runbook.
Marta Lopez: thanks Jia. Can you drop the exact curl to check routing?
Jia Park: Sure:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/v1/debug/routing?region=apac | jq .weights
```
Looks for `eu-west-2` and `us-central1` keys.
OncallBot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for gpux-3 starts in 2026-03-14T08:00Z and ends 2026-03-14T18:30Z. Posted to #eng-infra.
Samir Patel: copied. If pager hits for ASYNC-QUEUE latency > 99th, use the fallback route and escalate to infra after confirming weights.
Alex Chen: also FYI, we filed a ticket for a recurring small mem leak in the request router: RINF-4021. I assigned to @Marta.
Marta Lopez: I have the ticket and will triage after my morning stand. Plan: repro on staging, capture heap dump, and add an alert for slow growth.
Samir Patel: For handoff, can you confirm who owns on-call runbook edits? I remember security changes landed and broke a link last week.
Alex Chen: runbook edits are owned by the oncall rotation lead (that's me this week) but please open PRs against `infra/runbooks` and ping me for quick review. I'll merge small fixes.
Jia Park: FYI I found a small doc typo in the caching section; opened PR #789.
OncallBot: Incident digest: No open incidents. Recent pages: latency (auto-resolved) x3.
Samir Patel: Post-handoff tasks I will take: 1) follow up on RINF-4021 triage notes; 2) schedule a 30m retro if the mem leak reproduces; 3) confirm APAC fallback capacity after maintenance.
Alex Chen: I'm adding one more action: update the escalation matrix with the new SecOps contact (marta@redwood). Please add to the ticket.
Marta Lopez: done — updated RINF-4021 with SecOps contact and initial repro steps.
Samir Patel: I'll create a short retro invite for tomorrow 10:00 UTC and add the playbook, ticket, and heap dump link in the agenda. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood/meet/retros/4021
Jia Park: If anybody gets a page and needs quick mitigation: first check `curl` above, then run `rctl fallback apply --region eu-west-2 --weight 0.6` (temp). I'll add to the runbook snippet.
Alex Chen: note on communications: if there's customer impact, notify Customer Success with the template in `#customer-success`. Use summary + actions + ETA.
Samir Patel: can you paste the template?
Alex Chen: Copy:
```
Customer Impact Summary: <one-liner>
Affected Regions: <list>
User-facing Symptoms: <e.g., slow responses, timeouts>
Mitigation Steps Taken: <list>
ETA for full resolution: <HH:MM UTC>
Contact: <oncall email/phone>
```
Put in the CS ticket and ping @CS-Leads.
OncallBot: New page test scheduled at 2026-03-14T16:00Z to verify pager routing.
Marta Lopez: Quick note — SecOpsBot will be on-call for the weekend, I've added them to the escalation header.
Samir Patel: Last thing: coverage gap check — if both primary and secondary are paged simultaneously, follow the dual-page procedure in the playbook (assign a responder and push to infra). We had a 20-minute gap last week that we should avoid.
Alex Chen: Agreed. I'll make a follow-up ticket RINF-4022 to automate dual-page acknowledgements.
Jia Park: Thanks — adding RINF-4022 to backlog and will sketch the design tonight.
Marta Lopez: All clear from me. Handoff accepted, Samir is now primary.
Samir Patel: Taking over. Ping me for anything urgent. :thumbsup:
